content.text: Skip to content The Maryland Zoo in Baltimore Easter Events Here comes Peter Cotton Tail! Peter Cottontail is hopping down the bunny trail, and Maryland is ready to welcome him with some great Easter celebrations throughout the state. Here is a listing of egg hunts, bunny breakfasts, and more... The Maryland Zoo in Baltimore 1 PEEPshow 2 Bunny Train 3 Easter Egg Hunts at Green Meadows Farm 4 Carroll County Farmers' Market Easter Show 5 Bunny BonanZoo 6 Spring Eggstravagana 7 Easter Eggstraveganza at Mary's Land Farm 8 Easter Egg Festival 9 Easter at National Harbor 10 Egg Hunts Galore at Clark's Elioak Farm 1 PEEPshow 2 Bunny Train 3 Easter Egg Hunts at Green Meadows Farm 4 Carroll County Farmers' Market Easter Show 5 Bunny BonanZoo 6 Spring Eggstravagana 7 Easter Eggstraveganza at Mary's Land Farm 8 Easter Egg Festival 9 Easter at National Harbor 10 Egg Hunts Galore at Clark's Elioak Farm 1 PEEPshow 2 Bunny Train 3 Easter Egg Hunts at Green Meadows Farm 4 Carroll County Farmers' Market Easter Show 5 Bunny BonanZoo 6 Spring Eggstravagana 7 Easter Eggstraveganza at Mary's Land Farm 8 Easter Egg Festival 9 Easter at National Harbor 10 Egg Hunts Galore at Clark's Elioak Farm 1 of 10 10 Egg Hunts Galore at Clark's Elioak Farm Ellicott City Children of different ages (ages 1 to 3 and 4 to 6) will have a chance to hunt for eggs all day (10 AM, 10:30, 11 AM, 11:30, 12 noon, 12:30, 1 PM, 1:30, 2 PM, 2:30, 3 PM, 3:30, 4 PM, 4:30 and 5 PM) on both Saturday and Sunday March 28-29 and April 4-5. On weekdays (March 30-April 3) the hunts will be at 10:30, 11:30, 12:30, 2:30 and 3:30. The petting farm and rides will also be open on EASTER MONDAY, April 6, 2026 (but no egg hunts on Monday April 6) More Info... 1 PEEPshow PEEPshow is an Easter tradition in Maryland. "A Display of Marshmallow Masterpieces" with more than 150 sculptures, dioramas, graphic arts, oversized characters and mosaics created and inspired by PEEPS®. The sweet Maryland event attracts thousands. More info... Carroll County Arts Council 2 Bunny Train Walkersville Visit with the Easter Bunny on the Walkersville Southern Railroad train. Bunny will give each child an Easter gift. Enjoy juice and Uncle Ralph's cookies in the museum after the ride. Reservations required. More info.... Randy Serba / Visit Frederick 3 Easter Egg Hunts at Green Meadows Farm Ijamsville Enjoy egg hunts at the farm; there will be three hunts daily. Please sign up 30 minutes before hunts; note - the last admission is at 4pm. Admission includes free Easter egg hunt and petting farm. More info... Green Meadows Farm 4 Carroll County Farmers' Market Easter Show Westminster Bring your cameras for free pictures with the Easter Bunny. Nearly 100 local area vendors will offer fresh eggs, organic meats, home-baked goods, gourmet foods, candy, honey, nuts, seasonal plants, decorations and handmade quality crafts at the Carroll County Agriculture Center. More info.... Carroll County Farmers Market 5 Bunny BonanZoo Baltimore This annual family tradition features games, activities, crafts, live entertainment, and non-stop egg hunts! Plus, don’t miss a full schedule of animal enrichment where our animals will get some sweet Easter treats of their own! It’s a fun (and wild) way to celebrate the spring season. Bunny BonanZoo is a rain or shine event and is free with Zoo admission or membership. More info... The Maryland Zoo in Baltimore 6 Spring Eggstravagana Frederick This spring festival will be a Easter paradise where children are welcome to meet the Easter Bunny and families can relax and listen to music, enjoy local food, snacks and brew. There will be craft stations, hayrides, an egg hunt, story time, games, animal friends -- lots to enjoy at 2 Kids Farm. More info... 2 Kids Farm 7 Easter Eggstraveganza at Mary's Land Farm Ellicott City Find hidden eggs and enjoy a goody bag in exchange for the found eggs. Bring your own camera for the perfect springtime snapshot with the Easter Bunny. Get up close with goats, lambs, chickens, Kune Kune pigs, bunnies and more or book your own private mini lamb cuddling or mini bunny cuddling session (limited spots available – book early!). Enjoy classic lawn games, the Ride N’ Slide Mega Slide, the trackless train ride, play sets, racing bees, moon bounce, and more fun in the play area! Enjoy local food trucks each day for a quick bite, snack, or tasty treat! Relax and enjoy the farm atmosphere with family and friends. Meet, Sing and Dance with some of your favorite fairytale characters! More Info... Mary's Land Farm 8 Easter Egg Festival St. Mary's County join us each year for a family friendly event at the St. Mary’s County Fairgrounds that includes age appropriate egg hunts, visits with the Easter Bunny and Ms. Cottontail, a variety of craft vendors, arts and crafts activities, food trucks, entertainment and so much more! More Info... St. Mary's County 9 Easter at National Harbor National Harbor Get in the springtime spirit and celebrate Easter at National Harbor. Savor chef-curated menus at select restaurants, find the best sweets to fill those baskets and even meet the Easter Bunny himself. Scroll down for all of the hoppin' ways we're celebrating this year! More Info...
